03rd November 2026
Our Ref: WESTERN GROUND RENTS LIMITED

Good Morning Requester

Thank you for your recent enquiry concerning the above company name.
I have searched our archive records and found the following Information.

Company Name                 Western Ground Rents Limited
Company Number              00342092
Incorporated                      02/07/1938
Company Status                 Dissolved dated 22/08/1997

Company records for Western Ground Rents Limited were not sent to the National Archives.
All paper Records and Microfiche have been destroyed the only records available for this company are those that were captured on Image . You have already received the List

The Government’s view is that 20 years from dissolution is an appropriate length of time for Companies House to hold the records of dissolved companies and make them available for public inspection. This timeframe makes sure that users can still access a long-term picture of the activity of companies and directors.  As a result, the Companies Act 2006 (as amended by the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023) allows Companies House to remove any records for companies dissolved more than 20 years ago from public inspection.

We have implemented this directive, which means that the information you have requested is no longer available.

If you require any further Help related to Archive searches please reply to this email.

Kind Regards

Anne

Dear Companies House,

Re: COH2382411X - your reply of 2 November 2026

Thank you for your reply of 2 November 2026, which identifies Western Ground Rents Limited as company 00342092 (incorporated 2 July 1938, dissolved 22 August 1997) and Mountjoy Limited as company 00179977 (incorporated 27 February 1922, dissolved 31 January 2001). That answers my questions on the company numbers.

This email is not an order for any documents.

Your reply explains that paper records of England and Wales companies dissolved between 1992 and 2003 have been transferred to The National Archives or destroyed since July 2024, and that microfiche records were disposed of or transferred by early 2024. That is a general statement. It does not say what happened to the records of these two companies. Please answer each of the following as held or not held:

1. For company 00342092 and for company 00179977, do you hold any paper file, microfiche, image, index entry or other record, other than the filing history you listed? If so, what is held and where?
2. For each of the two companies, was its file transferred to The National Archives, destroyed or kept back? If so, please give the date, the series and reference, and the authority or retention schedule used.
3. Do you hold a transfer or destruction record for either file, and who handled it?
4. Is a preservation hold in place on these records and their indexes while my enquiry is open, as I asked on 10, 29 and 31 October? If not, please say so.
5. If this falls to be handled under the Freedom of Information Act 2000, please pass it to your FOI team and tell me the reference.

My emails of 29 and 31 October set out my other questions, including those on Mountjoy Limited's records and the 1926 and 1938 conveyances. I would be grateful for an answer to each of them that you can give.

Yours faithfully,

Requester
